corrections.text: The headline states Linderud's resignation is "Leaving Pacman Without a Sole Maintainer." Neither cited source explicitly makes this claim about Pacman specifically. Phoronix's report lists Pacman only among packages "now in need of a new maintainer" per Linderud's resignation email, and separately states, using the word "also" to signal a distinct fact, that he "was also the sole maintainer of WPA_Supplicant, fsverity-utils, and other packages" -- explicitly reserving 'sole maintainer' language for those two packages, not Pacman. The headline's characterization of Pacman is an inference, not a sourced fact.
